name: sinua-web-component-examples
description: <sinua-view> in plain HTML, Vue 3, Svelte 5, Solid and Angular (+ React 19 typings): minimal apps that double as the docs' framework samples and a regression check. Not part of any other install: npm ci here.

scripts.build: for a in html vue svelte solid; do (cd $a && vite build --logLevel error) || exit 1; done && (cd angular && ng build)
scripts.typecheck: (cd vue && vue-tsc -p tsconfig.json) && (cd svelte && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --fail-on-warnings) && (cd solid && tsc -p tsconfig.json) && (cd react19 && tsc -p tsconfig.json)
